_v2_changes: Rebuilt against the new 46.70s VO and the expanded asset pack, answering the founder's two notes. (1) 'images repeat': v1 placed 7 distinct assets across 20 scenes with one asset used 4 times; v2 places 21 distinct assets across 21 scenes, max repeat 1, and no source film reappears inside any 15s window. (2) 'motion is sparse / not documentary-grade': v1 authored asset_in offsets that the composition has no field for and silently ignored, so every archive scene actually rendered its film's opening title card - verified, 11 of the 15 films open on 0.4-2.3s of black plus a static card. v2 bakes the in-point into per-scene clips (see _clip_derivation) and uses the v2 fields - directional Ken Burns, three transition types, kinetic type, an animated evidence chart.
_clip_derivation: assets/sh*.mp4 are scene-specific cuts of the licensed masters in the same folder, made because MediaLayer in brand/remotion/PriceArchaeology.tsx plays media from t=0 and exposes no trim/startFrom prop. Each is rendered to 1080x1920 so fit:cover does no second upscale: 'full' shots are a focus-shifted 9:16 slice of the 4:3 frame (lanczos + light unsharp), 'frame' shots keep the whole 4:3 frame at full width over a blurred, darkened bed of itself. Recipe: scratchpad build_clips.py, in-points recorded in licenses.json.
_cut_method: Every in/out is a measured VO boundary, not a grid. Boundaries came from ffmpeg silencedetect on the new vo.mp3 at two thresholds (-40dB/0.20s for sentence gaps, -33dB/0.09s for the micro-gaps inside sentences); cuts sit at gap midpoints or at speech onsets. Three cuts are deliberately not on a sentence boundary and are noted on their scenes (s02/s03 split the 3.9s ARTIFACT sentence; s12 out-points on the word 'retailers'; s17 in-points on the word 'launch').
_cut_lengths: Excavation shots run 1.85-2.73s inside the 1.8-2.8s band with two documented exceptions: s08 (3.07s, the receipt, no VO boundary inside the sentence) and s15 (4.57s, the animated chart, which takes the whole of the longest unbroken VO line). The verdict block runs 5.41s across four scenes and the handoff holds 3.02s - both longer than anything in the excavation.
_layering: Archive on the bottom, desaturated 0.30-0.55 with procedural grain and vignette (grading, added by the composition, never content). Data on top: flat, sharp, tabular-lining numerals, no shadow beyond the legibility scrim. Amber #C8964B on every 2016 figure, cyan #00E5FF on every 2026 figure, hatched #8A6534 on the inflation-adjusted bar so an adjusted figure can never be mistaken for a nominal one.
_slideshow_guard: 17 of 21 scenes are moving footage (every clip measured: minimum inter-frame luma delta 1.33, median 3.4, max 13.6). The 4 stills are all held with a Ken Burns move (s04 1.12 right, s08 1.06 out, s16 1.05 out, s17 1.05 in) and none is held longer than 3.07s. Every scene except s16 and s18 carries animated type or a growing chart; s16 is the evidence artifact and s18 is the pre-verdict held frame, both of which are supposed to be quiet. No two consecutive scenes share a Ken Burns direction or a transition type.
_contrast_note: Found on rendered frames, not on paper: every brand text token is light (#FFFFFF data, #C8964B past, #00E5FF present) and the composition's only backing is a soft drop shadow, so type over a white document is unreadable. Rule applied here: white documents carry no type layer (s08, s16); token type only ever sits on a dark bed (s17 was moved off the LG pricing PDF onto a blank console screen at mean luma 65 for exactly this reason).
_captions_note: captions.json was regenerated VO-locked for this plan, from ffmpeg silencedetect runs on the new vo.mp3 - one chunk per spoken sentence, long sentences split proportionally, max 7 words. The previous file was built against the old VO and was drifting up to ~2.5s (verified on a rendered frame: at t=11.33s the burn-in read 'Entry line to entry line.' while the voice said 'Same resolution'). Do NOT regenerate this episode's captions with scripts/make_captions.py: it allocates chunks proportionally inside beat windows, and this plan's GAP beat deliberately starts at 7.054 (the odometer scene, where the two figures collide) rather than at the script header's 0:03, which would re-introduce the drift.
_odometer_note: Fires once, on GAP (s04), 800ms roll on the locked ease. Not restyled, not re-timed, not reused anywhere else in the plan.
_citation_note: C3: every scene with shows_price true carries a citation chip - s01, s04, s08, s09, s15, s16, s17. Chips enter and leave with the figure; none is faded early.
_evidence_discrepancy: evidence.json c5 carries inflation_adjusted_value 67.4, which contradicts its own text and its quoted BLS arithmetic (-76.2%). The chart title and the VO both use 76.2%, the value the quoted series actually produce. Unchanged from v1: trend-archaeologist still owns reconciling the field.
